verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail, now LegalZoom's Virtual Mail, documents that the mailbox works with LegalZoom business formation services and with Secretary of State status reports, so address plus entity formation from one provider is supported. It also lets you list the virtual address on public records. Missing for 10: lease-grade addresses for foreign qualification, residency-grade addresses, explicit LLC-formation bundling details, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can pair the address with entity services — LLC formation, lease-grade addresses for foreign qualification, or residency-grade addresses — from the same provider

citations.quote: Virtual Mail also works with your LegalZoom business formation services, including complimentary Secretary of State Status reports and other entitled services.
Earth Class Mail is now part of LegalZoom, bringing together America's #1 online legal services company and a proven virtual mail services provider
Protect your privacy by listing a virtual business address on public records instead of exposing your own to the public.
